test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**heasitete**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the incorrectly spelled word is '**heasitete**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Hesitate**'. • It means** 'to pause before you do something or before you make a decision, usually because you are uncertain or worried'.** (किसी बात पर हिचकना, झिकना, अनिश्‍चय या चिंता के कारण मंद गति से कुछ करना या निर्णय लेना) • *Example: He **hesitated** before going into the room.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Dealer**: a person whose business is buying and selling things. (खरीद-बिक्री का व्यवसाय करनेवाला व्यक्ति, व्‍यापारी) • **Queer**: strange or unusual. (विचित्र, अजीब या असामान्‍य) • **Obvious**: easily seen or understood; clear. (जो आसानी से दिखाई दे या समझ में आए; स्‍पष्‍ट) 49:Tea2, The erroneous part is '**Seldom has the discoveries**'.
